name: Tipton County, IN
findings: Tipton County has 72 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Tipton County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
61% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 68% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
